name: 29403 · Charleston, SC
findings: ZIP 29403 (Charleston) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29403 (Charleston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29403 (Charleston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
